parameters.content:
## JustJoinIT Scraper

Senior remote JVM roles from the JustJoinIT v2 API (`GET api.justjoin.it/v2/user-panel/offers`, header `Version: 2`).

**Schedule:** Every 15 minutes
**Source:** `justjoinit`

1. Get criteria from Job Hunter API
2. Fetch 3 pages of remote+senior offers
3. Match category against title + skills
4. Normalize & send to /jobs/ingest
